title: Segakore Sega Bible Mogitate SegaSaturn Soukangou
native_title: セガコレセガバイブルモギタテセガサターン。 創刊号 １９９７．１１
overview:
The first issue of the members-only information disc sent to Sega Partners, Sega's official Saturn fan club. This disc is the issue's special feature disc. A separate sample disc of Machi came in the same package.

A report on Sega's booth at the Tokyo Game Show 1997 autumn show includes game footage of titles such as Burning Rangers, Sonic R, Sakatsuku, Yakyutsuku and All Japan Pro Wrestling. An interview segment introduces the people behind upcoming Saturn games, and a new software corner offers trial versions of three upcoming games: Sega Touring Car Championship, Shining Force III Scenario 1 and Zero Divide. The issue also runs a reader vote to name the disc series.
